derivation.onset: Documentation-derived onset is Day +5 (first Grade 1 criterion, ICE 8/10; section 6.2). On the record's date (Day +4) there is only an excluded tremor (section 4.2, A11) and a partial ICE with no total (A6), so no gradeable assessment (A34). A record onset earlier than the first finding is a mismatch only with a formal Grade 0 assessment on that date (section 7.1 bullets 2-4), so the result is insufficient evidence (A18) plus the A24/NEW-6 flag.
derivation.max_grade: Highest per-assessment grade is 2 (ICE 5/10, awake, Day +6; section 3.3, 6.2 A2), equal to the record's 2, so 7.7 (section 7.7). Tremor is excluded and does not grade (section 4.2).

ambiguity_notes: Onset difference of -1 is reported for information although the category is 7.4 (section 7.9 withholds a difference only for the no-onset situations); a reviewer should treat it as not confirmed rather than as a mismatch. Flag 'record date matches an excluded or sub-threshold symptom' applies (tremor on Day +4, no qualifying finding that day). PMH ADHD (D02, 'no meds since age 18') is not documented developmental delay and is not an out-of-scope trigger (section 5); this is a judgement on the word 'delay'. No competing cause is documented; dexamethasone is treatment.
